description: Request a refill of a prescription for pickup at its Harris Teeter pharmacy, paid at the pharmacy. The pharmacy starts work on it and there is no cancel from here. Needs an active pharmacy session. NOT yet verified against a live refill: the first real request is the test. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

pickupDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today or later, during pharmacy hours.

name: ht_rx_request_refill
